product_one_liner.value: Reveal provides an AI-powered eDiscovery and investigations platform for law firms, corporate legal departments, and service providers.

pricing_page.notes: The /pricing page is a demo/contact form rather than a page listing plans or prices, and the homepage navigation/footer has no pricing link.

named_customers.notes: Both are named in customer success stories.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn displays 477 employees, which falls in this band, though its broader company-size label is 501–1,000.

hq_location.notes: Reveal identifies Chicago, USA as its North American headquarters.

eng_blog.notes: The index describes commentary and guidance for eDiscovery practice and features product, legal-practice, and marketing topics; it does not show two engineering-authored posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation site has multiple product and getting-started articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live job board lists open positions, but none has an AI, ML, or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: Reveal’s public materials describe aji and generic AI models, but do not identify a specific model or provider.

compliance_certs.notes: These are the requested items named on Reveal’s Trust Center.

last_funding.notes: The funding profile identifies a $200 million Growth Equity round on January 26, 2021; Reveal’s announcement says K1 invested more than $200 million in the combined organization.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified funding round was in January 2021, before the 18-month period.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live posting is for Account Executive, II.

launched_6mo.notes: October 2026 updates announced Reveal AI and new product features, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The announced CEO transition was dated October 14, 2025, before the 12-month window. I found no complete, dated current leadership roster or other evidence sufficient to confirm or rule out a change within the window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Account Executive posting names Salesforce as its CRM and lists ZoomInfo, Groove, and Gong among preferred sales tools.
